name: Input Buffer
description: Predictive input buffer: no more dead clicks from tapping a few ticks too early.

enabled.name: Enable Input Buffer
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, every input is passed straight to the game untouched.

target-tps.name: Target TPS
target-tps.description: Physics ticks per second you play at. Vanilla 2.2 is <cy>240</c>. All tick values below are written for 240 TPS and are auto-scaled to this value (e.g. 4 ticks at 240 TPS becomes 8 ticks at 480 TPS), so the real-time window stays the same if you use a TPS bypass.

debug-logging.name: Debug Logging
debug-logging.description: Write a <cy>log::info</c> line every time an input is saved, delayed, fired or expires. Open the Geode console to watch it live.

ground-orb-buffer.name: Ground & Orb Buffering
ground-orb-buffer.description: If you tap mid-air and let go before landing or reaching an orb, the click is kept alive for the buffer window and fires on contact.

buffer-ticks.name: Buffer Window (ticks)
buffer-ticks.description: How many physics ticks (at 240 TPS) an early tap stays alive, acting as if you were still holding. <cy>4</c> = 1 frame, <cy>24</c> = 0.1s, <cy>60</c> = 0.25s, <cy>120</c> = 0.5s (feels like a hold level).

tap-stretch.name: Tap Stretching
tap-stretch.description: Micro-taps are held for at least the minimum duration below so short inputs come out the same every time.

tap-stretch-ticks.name: Minimum Hold (ticks)
tap-stretch-ticks.description: Shortest hold a tap is stretched to, in ticks at 240 TPS.

assist-title.name: Smart Assist (Experimental)
assist-title.description: Windows only (does nothing on other platforms). All gamemodes.

smart-assist.name: Smart Assist
smart-assist.description:
On every press and release, the mod secretly plays out the next moment with your input on time, 1 tick later, 2 ticks later and so on. If on time would crash but slightly later gets you through the gap, your input is moved to the earliest timing that survives. It can only make inputs <cy>later</c>, never earlier.

<cr>Counts as a hack: lists and leaderboards will not accept runs with this on.</c>

assist-max-shift.name: Max Correction (ticks)
assist-max-shift.description: How far the assist may push an input later, in ticks at 240 TPS. <cy>4</c> = 1 frame, <cy>8</c> = 2 frames, <cy>16</c> = 4 frames.

assist-lookahead.name: Look Ahead (ticks)
assist-lookahead.description: How far into the future each timing is checked, in ticks at 240 TPS. Longer sees further past a gap but assumes you keep the same input that whole time. <cy>36</c> is about 0.15 seconds.

wave-mode.name: Wave Input Style
wave-mode.description:
<cy>Min Hold</c>: very short taps are held for a minimum time.
<cy>Min Gap</c>: after letting go, the next press is held back until a minimum gap has passed.
<cy>Grid Snap</c>: every press and release lands on a fixed tick grid.

wave-min-hold-ticks.name: Min Hold (ticks)
wave-min-hold-ticks.description: Used by <cy>Min Hold</c>. Shortest wave hold, in ticks at 240 TPS.

wave-min-gap-ticks.name: Min Gap (ticks)
wave-min-gap-ticks.description: Used by <cy>Min Gap</c>. Shortest gap between a release and the next press, in ticks at 240 TPS.

wave-grid-ticks.name: Grid Size (ticks)
wave-grid-ticks.description: Used by <cy>Grid Snap</c>. Inputs are pushed forward to the next multiple of this many ticks (at 240 TPS).
